```{r setup}
myPath <- "path_to_github" #ADD PATH TO GITHUB FOLDER

#load functions
source(paste0(myPath, "/functions/downstreamAnalysisFunctions.R"))

# import metadata
metadata_all<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/metadata.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# read in relevant files
k27me3_pcg_counts_corrected<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/correctedCounts/K27me3/k27me3_pcg_correctedCounts.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
k27me3_meta<-metadata_all[rownames(metadata_all) %in% colnames(k27me3_pcg_counts_corrected),]

k27me3_pcg_lm_corrected<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/K27me3/k27me3_pcg_lm_corrected.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# normalize for gene length
k27me3_lenNorm<-lenNormal(k27me3_pcg_counts_corrected,k27me3_pcg_lm_corrected, paste0(myPath,"/annotations/pcgSAF.txt"))
k27me3_pcg_counts_lenNorm<-k27me3_lenNorm[1][[1]]
k27me3_lm_lenNorm<-k27me3_lenNorm[2][[1]]

```

# Distribution of H3K27me3 across chrX
```{r k27me3_distribution}

# Read in linear modeling
k27me3_chrX1kb_lm<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/raw/K27me3/k27me3_chrX1kb_lm.txt"), row.names=1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
k27me3_chrX1kb_lm<-k27me3_chrX1kb_lm[is.na(k27me3_chrX1kb_lm$x_his_pval)==FALSE,]

# Figure 3A: Histogram
histplot<-formatPlot(histogram_xaVxi(k27me3_chrX1kb_lm, "pink", "deeppink2")+xlim(0,5)+xlab("H3K27me3 Level")+ylab("Frequency")+
  annotate("text", x=Inf, y=Inf, label=paste0("p: ", pVal), hjust=1.1, vjust=1.1, size=4))+geom_vline(xintercept = median(k27me3_chrX1kb_lm$intercept_his), color="pink", linetype='dashed')+
geom_vline(xintercept = median(k27me3_chrX1kb_lm$x_his_coeff), color="deeppink2", linetype='dashed')+ggtitle("H3K27me3 Distributions on Xa and Xi")+theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# Figure 3B: Point density plot 
k27me3_density<-densePlot_xaVxi(k27me3_chrX1kb_lm)+xlab("H3K27me3 on Xa")+ylab("H3K27me3 on Xi")+
  annotate("text", x=Inf, y=Inf, label=paste0("p: ", pVal), hjust=1.1, vjust=1.1, size=4) +xlim(0,4)+ylim(0,4)


```

# Track Plotting


```{r linearModelingPlots}
# Figure 3D: PRPS2

PRPS2_k27me3_line<-addLineInfo('PRPS2',k27me3_lm_lenNorm, PRPS2_k27me3 )
print(PRPS2_k4me3_peaks_line)

# Figure 3F: KDM6A

KDM6A_k27me3_line<-addLineInfo("KDM6A", k27me3_lm_lenNorm,KDM6A_k27me3)

# Figure 3H: XIST

print(XIST_k4me3_peaks_line)
```

# Compare Xi-silent vs Xi-expressed genes on Xa and Xi
```{r silVexp}
k27me3_lm_lenNorm<-expStatus((k27me3_lm_lenNorm))
k27me3_lm_lenNorm$xciStatus<-factor(k27me3_lm_lenNorm$xciStatus, levels=c("Xi-silent", "Xi-expressed", "not expressed", "XIST", "no XCI call"))
xaXicolorList_k27<-c("Xa"="pink", "Xi"="deeppink2")

# Figure 3I: Boxplot
k27me3_box<-formatPlot(xa_xi_box(k27me3_lm_lenNorm,"LCL")+scale_fill_manual(values=xaXicolorList_k27)+xlab("XCI Status")+ylab("H3K27me3 Level \n (Normalized counts)"))+ylim(-2,6)+theme(aspect.ratio=1)

```
